create_PyrenderRasterizer: create a PyrenderRasterizer instance with custom renderer flags and an optional model path template
add_object_model_to_renderer: add a 3D object model to the PyrenderRasterizer scene by obj_id with an optional mesh color
render_object_model: render a single object model from a given camera pose returning color, depth, and mask outputs
render_meshes: render a list of trimesh meshes from a camera pose with optional per-mesh colors into color and depth images
get_opencv_to_opengl_camera_trans: get the 4x4 transformation matrix that converts an OpenCV camera frame to an OpenGL camera frame
